description: Ask MyAtriumHealth to send a verification code to the account holder on the channel they chose. The code goes to them, not to this server.

channel.description: Channel the user chose, from the list mah_sign_in reported. 'totp' is an authenticator app — nothing is sent; read the code from the app.

resend.description: Set when re-sending after a code expired.

name: mah_send_verification_code
